While unsuccessfully trying to source this image, I learned that Hitler had a huge sweet tooth, reportedly eating 2 pounds or 1 Kg of chocolate per day.

Hitler was reputed to put seven teaspoons of sugar in each cup of tea
Adolf probably had the most famous sweet tooth on record. Despite being a vegetarian who also abstained from hard alcohol, Hitler's weakness for candy and pastries was well known, and admirers always made sure to bring a box of chocolates or cake or pastries when they came to see the Führer. So, just how sweet were his teeth?
He also supposedly added sugar to wine because he found it too bitter otherwise, and plied all his guests with ice cream and candy. In fact, Hitler's favorite dessert chef, Gerhardt Shtammer, claims that Hitler asked him to make delectable desserts right up to the very end, when they were trapped in Hitler's bunker with hard-core Nazi holdouts. According to Shtammer, Hitler's favorite desserts were Éclairs decorated with little swastikas and strudel.
